metadata.title: Drainage & Sewage Management Departments and Facilities in Pune
metadata.description: Geographical coordinates, capacities, operational roles, and contact information for the Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) Drainage Department, JICA Mula-Mutha River Pollution Abatement Project, major Sewage Treatment Plants (STPs), pumping stations, and zonal drainage maintenance divisions.

administrative_headquarters_and_project_.name: PMC Drainage Department Central Head Office
administrative_headquarters_and_project_.role_and_responsibilities: Apex civic administration for citywide sewerage network design, stormwater drains, drainage connection approvals, manhole inspection, and superintending engineer oversight.
administrative_headquarters_and_project_.address: Second Floor, Sawarkar Bhavan, Congress House Road, Shivajinagar

administrative_headquarters_and_project_.name: Pollution Abatement of River Mula-Mutha (PARMM) JICA Project Cell
administrative_headquarters_and_project_.governing_body: Pune Municipal Corporation & National River Conservation Directorate (NRCD)
administrative_headquarters_and_project_.role_and_responsibilities: Overseeing the construction of 11 new centralized STPs (396 MLD additional capacity), 113.6 km of trunk sewer network, intermediate pumping stations, and SCADA monitoring under JICA funding.

administrative_headquarters_and_project_.name: PCMC Sewerage & Drainage Department Headquarters
administrative_headquarters_and_project_.role_and_responsibilities: Planning, maintenance, and operation of sewer lines, storm water networks, and industrial/domestic sewage treatment infrastructure in Pimpri-Chinchwad.
administrative_headquarters_and_project_.address: PCMC Main Administrative Building, Mumbai - Pune Road, Pimpri Colony
